annotations.text: Nearby = the Mac's Helm server is seen over Bonjour on the same Wi-Fi (and it's the paired Mac). On another network the pill never shows, even though the phone stays connected over Tailscale.
Haptics: a short tap when the run finishes or the agent needs you, while the Mac is nearby and the app is open.
Later: Live Activity buttons and the Action button.

Recommend 7A + 7D: the header keeps its two buttons; Open on Mac is the first item in ··· and in the long-press menu on Home, shown only while the Mac is nearby. 7C is one tap but sits over the thread the whole time you're near the Mac.
Chosen: 2A·3, the menu in the header.

Only Settle and Snooze, down by the thumb. Recommend 8D: two buttons right above the microphone, always in the same place; with threads waiting, Settle becomes "Settle & next". 8E saves a row, but the button turns from Stop into Settle as the run ends, right where the finger may be. 8B: tapping the title still lists every thread.
